title: Changes
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Vesta & Silas in Terrasol on an acoustic sensory quest to explore Changes.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'Changes', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of Changes to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: Gentle 80 BPM Weather-Shift Pulse (Observe What Shifts vs. What Stays Constant)
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Evaluating Evidence (S-33): The song notices 'It's sunny outside. Yesterday it rained. Somewhere it might snow tomorrow'—what outdoor clues prove weather is always changing?
Examining Assumptions (S-30): When a stormy or rainy day arrives, why might we assume the whole day is ruined—and what real-world benefits does changing weather bring?
Plausible Inferences (S-32): Why does the song contrast changing weather with unchanging love—what stays steady in a caring family even when moods or seasons shift?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Act out sun, rain, and snow with hands, then hug self for 'steady love'.
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Name two things that change every week and two loving promises that stay steady.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Compare evidence of seasonal/weather shifts across places while explaining why constants anchor security.

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to Changes.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Terrasol.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Actively participates in screen-free multi-sensory rhythm rituals and articulates key conceptual observations.
